title: Writing to a Buffer
goal: Pass a mutable buffer reference to a generic I/O writer.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Standard Traits

hints: Look at the receiver type expected by `Write::write_all`.
To keep using buf in main after writing, borrow it mutably rather than moving it.
explanation: `Write::write_all` requires a mutable reference to the target stream or buffer. Passing `&mut buf` allows the function to mutate the buffer while keeping ownership in `main`. Shared references like `&buf` produce error `E0596` because shared data cannot be mutated. Taking `W` by value moves `buf` and produces `E0382` when reading `buf` later.
